picks.name: KiF Productions
picks.source_note: Music To Watch Seeds Grow By already seeded (two earlier editions from this plant-themed cassette series -- Brian d'Souza's Sunflowers and Patricia Wolf's Yarrow -- were already published, caught via dedup check). This is the series' next edition, not yet covered.
picks.bio: "Passiflora" (Music To Watch Seeds Grow By 010, shipped around August 12, 2026) is the tenth edition of the label's plant-themed cassette series, from English duo KiF Productions (Will Cookson and Tom Haverly) -- five tracks tracing the passion flower's life cycle, dedicated to Keith McIvor (Optimo) and his Tranquility Mixes.
picks.why_listen: Calm, structured ambient built around a single plant's biology -- good for a slow-build opener or a come-down stretch late in a set.

release.title: Music To Watch Seeds Grow By 010: Passiflora
